title: Portland Palestinian Faces Deportation as West Bank Settler Violence Escalates
detail: A Palestinian resident of the Portland, Oregon area faces deportation to the West Bank amid an escalation in settler violence, highlighting the intersection of US immigration enforcement and the Israeli-Palestinian conflict for diaspora communities. The case underscores how deteriorating conditions in the occupied West Bank — including repeated settler raids and IDF-protected incursions — are being cited in US immigration proceedings involving Palestinian nationals.
